subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Later, students wrote more carefully.”?
options: Others chose longer books they truly liked.
They recommended books to friends and warned others about sad endings.
They wrote about confusing lessons, helpful friends, and times they were proud.
Some visitors even helped others find books.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Others chose longer books they truly liked.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Later, students wrote more carefully. They recommended books to friends and warned others about sad endings.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「They wrote about confusing lessons, helpful friends, and times they were proud.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some visitors even helped others find books.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Later, students wrote more carefully. They recommended books to friends and warned others about sad endings.」，答案為「They recommended books to friends and warned others about sad endings.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They recommended books to friends and warned others about sad endings.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
